articles.title: AMD is taking advantage of Intel's weakness: Analyst on earnings
articles.mainIdea: AMD is taking advantage of Intel's weakness: Analyst on earnings
articles.summary: Yahoo Finance Video: AMD is taking advantage of Intel's weakness: Analyst on earnings. Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) stock is falling in Tuesday's extended hours trading despite topping fourth quarter estimates on the top and bottom line, as well as outpacing revenue guidance forecasts. Benchmark Company managing director and senior semiconductor research analyst Cody Acree comes on Market Domination Overtime to elaborate on how AMD is able to "take advantage" of Intel's (INTC) recent weaknesss. To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination Overtime. Related tickers mentioned: AMD.
